camel_example: aliyun agentidentity CreateUser --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --UserName alice --Description '数据分析师' --Email 'alice@example.com' --DisplayName Alice --UserPoolName 'my-agent-userpool' --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a user in a user pool
kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity create-user --user-pool-name my-agent-userpool --user-name alice --display-name Alice --description '数据分析师' --email alice@example.com --status Enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUser

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The username. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-), and must be 3 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。支持英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、点（.）和连字符（-），长度 3~128 个字符
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The display name of the user. It must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户显示名称。长度 0~128 个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the user. It must be 0 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户描述。长度 0~256 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The email address of the user
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
The status of the user. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
用户状态。取值：
Enabled：启用。
Disabled：禁用

Type.description_en:
The type of the user. Valid values:
Manual: The user is manually created by calling an API operation.
JIT: The user is created through JIT.
SCIM: The user is synchronized through the System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol.
SYNC_DINGTALK: The user is synchronized from DingTalk
